title: SiC gate driver design
purpose: Specify the isolated gate-drive circuit for a SiC MOSFET: isolation, rails, R_G,ON/R_G,OFF, off-state immunity, DESAT protection and controller interface.
applicable_conditions: SiC MOSFETs (discrete or module) in bridges or single-ended stages
Bus voltage within the driver IC's isolation and working-voltage rating
not_applicable: Non-isolated bootstrap low-voltage drivers (e.g. the 48 V Buck V1 benchmark)
principles: Isolated driver for every switch position (PRD-09301 §1.2)
Driver referenced to the Kelvin source
Gate levels within device absolute maxima, negative turn-off preferred in half bridges unless 0 V is justified
Peak gate current needed at both edges
Off-state immunity via capacitance ratio, negative bias, low R_G,OFF and short-path Miller clamp
Hardware DESAT protection with blanking, soft turn-off and latched fault
Gate discharge resistor at the device side of R_G
Differential or filtered signalling with hardware interlock
procedure: Collect device gate limits, Q_G, capacitance ratio, R_DS(on)(T), short-circuit withstand
Select isolation rating for the node
Select rails and bias supply (SKILL-004) and check the power budget
Choose starting R_G values from datasheet curves
Design DESAT trip and blanking with CB-GD-001 formulas
Add discharge resistor, rail decoupling and clamp
Record instance values and hand constraints to SKILL-002
component_considerations: Driver isolation, CMTI, peak current, split outputs, clamp, DESAT threshold accuracy, soft turn-off, UVLO, delay
DESAT diode voltage rating and recovery
Fast Schottky steering diodes if used
verification_methods: Recompute DESAT trip and blanking (EC-001, EC-002)
Bias power and f_sw limit (EC-003, EC-004)
Netlist checks of gate, clamp and DESAT paths (EC-022, EC-023, EC-026)
Double-pulse tests; off-state V_GS with isolated probe at device side of R_G
Short-circuit, UVLO and interlock fault injection
known_limitations: No AIPE simulation or hardware test
Module guidance applied to discretes only where physics is identical
